recap: Utterson returns home troubled and studies Jekyll’s will, which leaves everything to Edward Hyde if Jekyll vanishes. He calls it madness and fears disgrace. At Cavendish Square, Lanyon says Jekyll grew too fanciful years ago and has never heard of Hyde. Unable to sleep, Utterson resolves to hunt Hyde. Keeping watch by the by-street door, he accosts a small man with a key, who admits Jekyll is out, gives his Soho address, then snarls and disappears inside. At Jekyll’s house, Poole confirms Hyde has a key, comes by the dissecting room, and all servants must obey him. Utterson goes home fearing Jekyll is in deep waters.
